arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export CODEX_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.codex PATH=/home/ubuntu/codex-agent/node_modules/.bin:$PATH
unset OPENAI_API_KEY CODEX_API_KEY OPENAI_BASE_URL
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,shutil,tempfile,os,sys,stat,re,json
from pathlib import Path
target='martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex'
expected='2187dd2d3e3e195250b9eacd88767c2fab4f1a06'
tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rea-plcodex-maturity-inspection-',dir='/tmp'))
tmp.chmod(0o700)
try:
 src=tmp/'repo'
 subprocess.run(['git','clone','--quiet','--depth','2','--branch','main','https://github.com/'+target+'.git',str(src)],check=True,timeout=75,capture_output=True)
 got=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
 assert got==expected,'HEAD_CHANGED '+got
 print('PREFLIGHT_TARGET_VERIFIED',got,flush=True)
 cli=shutil.which('codex')
 if not cli or not Path(cli).is_file():raise RuntimeError('CODEX_CLI_MISSING')
 p=subprocess.run([cli,'login','status'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
 print('CODEX_CLI_CHATGPT_LOGGED_IN',p.returncode==0 and 'Logged in using ChatGPT' in p.stdout+p.stderr,flush=True)
 print('MAIN_FILE_COUNT',len(subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'ls-files'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()),flush=True)
 keep=['codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py','codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py',
       'codex/smart.py','codex/scope_discovery.py','CODEX_COORDINATION.md','AGENTS.md']
 for path in keep:
  s=(src/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
  print('FILE',path,'lines',len(s.splitlines()),'sha',__import__('hashlib').sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],flush=True)
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'grep','-n','-E','owner_coordinator_ingress|coordinator run|/VPS/issues|submit_owner_order'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print('LEGACY_COORDINATOR_REFERENCES',p.returncode,'\n'.join(p.stdout.splitlines()[:90])[:9500].replace('\n',' | '),flush=True)
 def cli_run(name,args):
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','codex.smart','plan','--task',args,'--repo-dir',str(src)],cwd=src,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
  response={}
  if p.stdout.strip().startswith('{'):
   try:
    j=json.loads(p.stdout)
    response={'status':j.get('status'),'mode':j.get('mode'),'agent_count':j.get('agent_count'),
              'work_items':[{'id':z.get('id'),'paths':z.get('paths')} for z in j.get('tasks',[])],
              'warnings':j.get('warnings')}
   except ValueError:response={'parse_error':True}
  print('NATURAL_CLI_'+name, 'exit',p.returncode,'result',json.dumps(response,ensure_ascii=False)[:2500],
        'stderr',p.stderr[-240:].replace('\n',' | '),flush=True)
 cli_run('CODEx',"Corrige uma pequena falha no codex/smart.py e verifica os testes.")
 cli_run('LEGACY',"Corrige a documentacao sobre o Coordenador na VPS sem criar outro Coordenador.")
 cli_run('TESTS',"Corrige um typo no teste do Codex e valida os testes relacionados.")
 for pth in ['codex/tests/test_owner_coordinator_ingress.py','codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py']:
  text=(src/pth).read_text()
  print('LEGACY_'+pth.replace('/','_'),[(m.start(),text[m.start():m.start()+80].replace('\n',' ')) for m in list(re.finditer('submit_owner_order|VPS/issues|coordinator run',text))[:12]],flush=True)
 status=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 assert not status.stdout
 print('REA_INSPECTION_READ_ONLY_PASS')
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(tmp)
 print('TEMP_CLONE_CLEANED',flush=True)
PY
